_readme: Curated project list shown on the map with filled markers. Add or edit entries by hand. Required: name, lat, lon, status (Announced | Under construction | Operational). Optional: company, location, capacity_mw, investment_usd_b, announced (YYYY-MM), notes, source_url. The entries below are starting points from widely reported public news as of 2025 and should be checked against current sources; set verified to true once you have.

projects.name: Stargate Abilene
projects.notes: Flagship Stargate campus, first buildings energized in 2025 with more under way.

projects.name: Hyperion
projects.notes: Planned to scale toward 5 GW over time, served by new gas generation from the local utility.

projects.name: Prometheus
projects.notes: Roughly 1 GW AI cluster expected online in 2026.

projects.name: Colossus
projects.notes: Converted factory brought online in months; a second site in the area is being built out.

projects.name: Fairwater
projects.notes: AI datacenter on the former Foxconn site, first phase due online in 2026 with a second phase announced.

projects.name: Project Rainier
projects.notes: Large campus tied to AI training capacity; first buildings in service in 2025.

projects.name: Frontier
projects.notes: Named as one of the Stargate expansion sites with Oracle.

projects.name: Stargate Doña Ana County
projects.location: Doña Ana County, New Mexico, US
projects.notes: One of the five Stargate sites announced in September 2025.

projects.name: Stargate Lordstown
projects.notes: Former auto plant site being converted for AI compute.

projects.name: AWS Pennsylvania
projects.notes: Two campuses, Salem Township and Falls Township; the Salem site sits next to a nuclear plant.

projects.name: Google Oklahoma
projects.notes: Expansion of the existing Pryor campus plus a new Stillwater site.

projects.name: Crusoe Cheyenne
projects.notes: Powered by on-site gas generation with plans for added renewables.

projects.name: Project Matador
projects.notes: Very large planned campus combining gas, solar and proposed nuclear; early stage.

projects.name: QTS Fayetteville
projects.notes: Multi-building hyperscale campus south of Atlanta.

projects.name: Data Center Alley
projects.company: Equinix, Digital Realty, AWS, Microsoft, Google and others
projects.notes: Loudoun County, Virginia: the largest concentration of data centers in the world, still expanding.

projects.name: Google The Dalles
projects.notes: One of Google's first large data centers, opened in 2006, expanded many times since.

projects.name: Microsoft Quincy
projects.notes: Hydropower-fed campus on the Columbia River, operating since 2007.

projects.name: Meta Prineville
projects.notes: Meta's first owned data center, opened in 2011 and expanded many times.

projects.name: Google Council Bluffs
projects.notes: Long-running Google campus with multi-billion dollar expansions.
